method: Annotated by Grok Bot reading each tale in full (model-assisted), then checked by script: each cue must be an exact quotation (15 words or fewer) found within 4 lines of the cited line. Moves follow Propp's definition: a new move begins with each new villainy (A) or lack (a). Fused functions narrated in one sentence are listed in Propp's canonical order. 'implicit' marks a function that the story requires but never narrates. X marks an episode that fits no function.
